name: Tidepool Galaxy
description: A shallow coastal tidepool at night contains swirling miniature galaxies and tiny fish swimming through stars.
prompt: A single magical close-up of a rocky ocean tidepool at night, where the water swirls with miniature spiral galaxies, glowing nebulae, and constellations. Tiny silver fish swim through star clusters, sea anemones shimmer like planets, wet rocks reflect cosmic light. Deep indigo and teal palette, ultra-detailed macro photography style, dreamy and serene, no text, no logos, no watermarks.
caption: Look closely—the universe might be hiding in a tidepool. What would you wish for here?
